स्थायी विद्यालय संपत्ति रजिस्टर (Permanent School Property Register)
कार्यालय आकस्मिक व्यय रजिस्टर (Office Contingency Expenditure Register)
प्रवेश एवं निकासी रजिस्टर (Admission and Withdrawal Register)

questions.question_english: Which register in a school is considered the absolute legal proof of a student’s enrollment and is required permanently?
options_english: Teacher’s Daily Academic Diary
Permanent School Property Register
Office Contingency Expenditure Register
Admission and Withdrawal Register
questions.explanation_english:
Under the Delhi School Education Rules (DSER), 1973 (specifically Rule 140 governing registers and records to be maintained by recognized schools) and Departmental Record Retention Schedules, the 'Admission and Withdrawal Register' (commonly referred to as the Scholar Register) is a permanent statutory legal document.

Key legal and administrative attributes of the Admission and Withdrawal Register:
1. Conclusive Evidentiary Value: It serves as absolute, primary legal evidence in courts of law regarding a student's date of birth, parentage, admission date, class history, caste/category, and school leaving details under the Indian Evidence Act, 1872.
2. Permanent Preservation: Unlike routine registers (such as attendance registers or teacher diaries which are retained for 3 to 5 years), the Admission and Withdrawal Register can never be weeded out or destroyed. It is categorized as a Class 'A' permanent archive.
3. Contents Recorded:
   - Admission Number (Scholar No.).
   - Full student name and verified parental particulars.
   - Verified Date of Birth (in figures and words) supported by statutory birth certificate.
   - Date of admission and class admitted to.
   - Previous school attended and Transfer Certificate (TC) number.
   - Date of leaving, reasons for withdrawal, and SLC/TC issuance record.
4. Principal's Custodianship: The Head of School / Principal is personally and statutorily accountable for the safe custody, physical integrity, and tamper-proof maintenance of this register.

Therefore, the Admission and Withdrawal Register is the permanent legal proof of student enrollment, making Option (D) the correct answer.
questions.explanation_hindi:
दिल्ली स्कूल शिक्षा नियमावली (DSER), 1973 के नियम 140 (विद्यालय द्वारा संधारित किए जाने वाले अभिलेख) तथा अभिलेख प्रतिधारण अनुसूची (Record Retention Schedule) के अंतर्गत 'प्रवेश एवं निकासी रजिस्टर' (Admission and Withdrawal Register / Scholar Register) एक स्थायी वैधानिक दस्तावेज है।

प्रवेश एवं निकासी रजिस्टर की विधिक एवं प्रशासनिक महत्ता:
1. निर्णायक साक्ष्य मूल्य: भारतीय साक्ष्य अधिनियम के तहत यह किसी छात्र की जन्म तिथि, माता-पिता का नाम, प्रवेश की तिथि, शैक्षणिक इतिहास तथा विद्यालय छोड़ने के विवरण के संबंध में न्यायालयों और प्रशासनिक निकायों में प्राथमिक व अकाट्य कानूनी साक्ष्य माना जाता है।
2. स्थायी संरक्षण (Permanent Record): जहां उपस्थिति पंजिका अथवा शिक्षक डायरी जैसे नियमित अभिलेखों को 3 से 5 वर्षों के बाद नष्ट किया जा सकता है, वहीं प्रवेश एवं निकासी रजिस्टर को कभी भी नष्ट नहीं किया जा सकता। इसे 'श्रेणी A' (Class 'A') का स्थायी अभिलेख माना जाता है जिसे सदैव सुरक्षित रखना अनिवार्य है।
3. दर्ज किए जाने वाले विवरण:
   - छात्र का प्रवेश क्रमांक (Scholar / Admission Number)।
   - छात्र का पूरा नाम, माता-पिता/अभिभावक का नाम तथा स्थायी पता।
   - सत्यापित जन्म तिथि (अंकों और शब्दों में) तथा जन्म प्रमाण पत्र का संदर्भ।
   - प्रवेश की तिथि तथा किस कक्षा में प्रवेश दिया गया।
   - पूर्व विद्यालय का नाम और स्थानांतरण प्रमाण पत्र (TC) विवरण।
   - विद्यालय छोड़ने की तिथि, निकासी का कारण तथा जारी किए गए स्थानांतरण प्रमाण पत्र का क्रमांक।
4. विद्यालय प्रमुख का उत्तरदायित्व: विद्यालय प्रमुख (प्रधानाचार्य) इस रजिस्टर के सुरक्षित संधारण, भौतिक संरक्षण तथा इसमें किसी भी अनाधिकृत फेरबदल को रोकने के लिए व्यक्तिगत रूप से उत्तरदायी होता है।

अतः प्रवेश एवं निकासी रजिस्टर छात्र के नामांकन का स्थायी कानूनी प्रमाण है, जिससे विकल्प (D) सही उत्तर है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (D) Admission and Withdrawal Register

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: The Admission and Withdrawal Register is the official permanent legal record maintained by an educational institution. It captures essential student enrollment details including date of birth, admission number, parent names, and withdrawal history. It serves as permanent legal proof of enrollment and must be preserved indefinitely by the school management.

questions.question_english: What is the primary statutory function of the Internal Complaints Committee (ICC) constituted in educational institutions under the POSH Act, 2013 and aligned with Rule 3C of the CCS (Conduct) Rules, 1964?
options_english: To arbitrate pay anomalies, MACP issues, and allowance disputes among staff
To inquire into, redress, and resolve complaints of sexual harassment of women at the workplace
To systematically assess annual confidential reports and teacher performance appraisals
To conduct internal financial audits and verify school operational funds
questions.explanation_english: Under Section 4 of the Sexual Harassment of Women at Workplace (Prevention, Prohibition and Redressal) Act, 2013 (POSH Act), every workplace—including all government, aided, and private schools—employing 10 or more persons must constitute an Internal Complaints Committee (ICC) headed by a senior woman employee. In Central and Delhi Government services, this is codified under Rule 3C of the CCS (Conduct) Rules, 1964. Under the proviso to Rule 14(2) of the CCS (CCA) Rules, 1965, the ICC functions as the Inquiring Authority appointed by the Disciplinary Authority for inquiring into charges of sexual harassment, and its inquiry report serves as an inquiry report in departmental disciplinary proceedings.
questions.explanation_hindi: कार्यस्थल पर महिलाओं का लैंगिक उत्पीड़न (निवारण, प्रतिषेध और प्रतितोष) अधिनियम, 2013 (POSH Act) की धारा 4 और केंद्रीय सिविल सेवा (आचरण) नियम, 1964 के नियम 3C के तहत प्रत्येक शैक्षणिक संस्थान और कार्यालय में एक 'आंतरिक शिकायत समिति' (ICC) का गठन अनिवार्य है। इस समिति का प्राथमिक कार्य कार्यस्थल पर महिला कर्मचारियों के लैंगिक उत्पीड़न संबंधी शिकायतों की निष्पक्ष जांच करना, पीड़ित को संरक्षण देना तथा निवारण रिपोर्ट प्रस्तुत करना है। CCS (CCA) नियम, 1965 के नियम 14(2) के तहत ICC को औपचारिक जांच प्राधिकारी (Inquiring Authority) का दर्जा प्राप्त होता है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (B) To handle cases of sexual harassment at the workplace

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Every educational institution must constitute an Internal Complaints Committee in accordance with statutory requirements under the POSH Act and CCS Conduct Rule 3C. The committee is dedicated to addressing, investigating, and resolving complaints of sexual harassment at the workplace, ensuring a safe, secure, and supportive environment for all female employees.

उपर्युक्त कथनों के आलोक में, सही उत्तर का चयन कीजिए:

questions.question_english:
Given below are two statements, one labelled as Assertion (A) and the other as Reason (R):
Assertion (A): The Directorate of Education's e-governance platform (edudel.nic.in) has streamlined school administration by unifying student admissions, staff attendance, mis-reporting, and payroll processing.
Reason (R): Following the full implementation of digital modules on edudel.nic.in, physical/manual registers are completely banned and have been stripped of all statutory and evidentiary legal validity.
In light of the above statements, choose the most appropriate answer:
options_english: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
questions.explanation_english:
Assertion (A) is correct, but Reason (R) is false:
- Assertion (A) is true: The Directorate of Education (DoE), GNCTD, introduced the 'edudel.nic.in' MIS and e-governance portal to digitize key administrative processes—including online Plan and Non-Plan admissions, teacher transfers, student performance tracking, Mid-Day Meal monitoring, and employee payroll management. This has significantly enhanced administrative efficiency, transparency, and data integrity across Delhi government schools.
- Reason (R) is false: Physical registers (such as the DDO Cash Book GAR-3, Contingent Register GAR-27, Permanent Stock and Consumable Registers, and Admission/Withdrawal Registers under Rule 133 of DSEAR 1973) have NOT been banned or rendered legally invalid. In statutory audits, judicial inquiries, and under Rule 145/146 of DSEAR 1973, original physical records, authenticated signed entries, and hardcopy vouchers continue to hold paramount evidentiary value and legal validity alongside digital entries.
questions.explanation_hindi:
अभिकथन (A) सही है, परंतु कारण (R) गलत है:
- अभिकथन (A) सत्य है: दिल्ली सरकार के शिक्षा निदेशालय द्वारा संचालित 'edudel.nic.in' पोर्टल ने स्कूल प्रशासन को डिजिटल बनाकर छात्र प्रवेश (प्लान व नॉन-प्लान एडमिशन), शिक्षक स्थानांतरण, उपस्थिति, परीक्षा परिणाम तथा पे-रोल (वेतन) प्रबंधन को एक ही मंच पर एकीकृत और पारदर्शी किया है।
- कारण (R) असत्य है: ई-गवर्नेंस लागू होने के बावजूद भौतिक (मैनुअल) रजिस्टरों को न तो पूरी तरह प्रतिबंधित किया गया है और न ही उनकी वैधानिक व कानूनी वैधता समाप्त हुई है। दिल्ली स्कूल शिक्षा नियम (DSEAR) 1973 के नियम 133 के तहत छात्र प्रवेश रजिस्टर (Scholar's Register), DDO रोकड़ बही (Cash Book), स्टॉक रजिस्टर तथा मूल वाउचर वैधानिक ऑडिट और न्यायिक जांच के लिए अनिवार्य एवं प्राथमिक साक्ष्य बने हुए हैं।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (C) A is true but R is false

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: E-governance platforms like edudel.nic.in have modernized school administration by centralizing online operations including attendance, admissions, and payroll. However, physical registers and records continue to retain legal validity for official audits, statutory compliance, and operational backup, making the claim that manual registers hold no legal standing completely false under current rules.

questions.question_english: Under Rule 10 of the Central Civil Services (CCA) Rules, 1965, what is the maximum duration for which an order of suspension remains valid in the first instance before it must be evaluated and extended by a designated Review Committee?
options_english: 30 days
60 days
90 days
120 days
questions.explanation_english:
Under Rule 10(6) and 10(7) of the CCS (CCA) Rules, 1965, an order of suspension made or deemed to have been made by the competent authority is subject to mandatory periodic review.

Statutory Timelines:
1. Initial 90-Day Limit: An order of suspension remains valid in the first instance for a maximum period of ninety (90) days. Before the expiry of this 90-day window, a Review Committee constituted for this purpose must formally review the case on merits and recommend whether to extend or revoke the suspension.
2. Automatic Invalidation: If the suspension is not reviewed and a formal extension order is not issued before the expiration of 90 days from the effective date of suspension, the suspension order becomes legally invalid and lapses automatically (as settled by the Hon'ble Supreme Court in Union of India v. Dipak Mali).
3. Subsequent Extensions: Any subsequent extension recommended by the Review Committee can be for a period not exceeding 180 days at a time.
Hence, 90 days is the maximum duration in the first instance (Option C).
questions.explanation_hindi:
केंद्रीय सिविल सेवा (वर्गीकरण, नियंत्रण एवं अपील) नियमावली, 1965 के नियम 10(6) एवं 10(7) के अनुसार, सक्षम प्राधिकारी द्वारा जारी निलंबन आदेश की समय-समय पर वैधानिक समीक्षा अनिवार्य है।

महत्वपूर्ण कानूनी समय-सीमाएं:
1. प्रथम दृष्टया 90 दिनों की वैधता: निलंबन आदेश प्रथम बार में अधिकतम 90 दिनों की अवधि के लिए ही प्रभावी रहता है। इस 90 दिन की अवधि समाप्त होने से पूर्व सक्षम समीक्षा समिति (Review Committee) द्वारा मामले की समीक्षा कर निलंबन को आगे बढ़ाने अथवा रद्द करने की संस्तुति करना आवश्यक है।
2. स्वतः निरस्तीकरण (Lapse): यदि 90 दिनों के भीतर समीक्षा कर विस्तार आदेश जारी नहीं किया जाता है, तो निलंबन आदेश कानूनन स्वतः निष्प्रभावी और अमान्य हो जाता है (दीपक माली बनाम भारत संघ मामले में सर्वोच्च न्यायालय द्वारा स्थापित सिद्धांत)।
3. आगामी विस्तार: समीक्षा समिति की अनुशंसा पर निलंबन को एक बार में अधिकतम 180 दिनों की अवधि के लिए बढ़ाया जा सकता है।
अतः पहली बार में अधिकतम अवधि 90 दिन है (विकल्प C)।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (C) 90 days

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Under disciplinary rules, an order of suspension issued against a government servant remains valid for an initial period not exceeding ninety days. Before this term expires, a designated Review Committee must formally evaluate the case to decide whether to extend or revoke the suspension, ensuring administrative actions remain subject to periodic review.

questions.question_english: Under Rule 172 of the General Financial Rules (GFR), 2017, advance payment to private suppliers is generally prohibited. However, for Annual Maintenance Contracts (AMC), what is the maximum advance payment that may be sanctioned to a contractor/firm?
options_english: An amount exceeding the total annual contract value
Up to the amount payable for six months under the contract
Up to the total amount payable for one full year
No advance payment is permitted under any circumstances
questions.explanation_english:
Under Rule 172(1) of the General Financial Rules (GFR), 2017:
1. General Financial Prudence: Ordinarily, payments for services rendered or supplies made should be released only after the services have been rendered or supplies accomplished satisfactorily.
2. Exception for Maintenance Contracts (Rule 172(1)(b)): In the case of maintenance contracts (such as Annual Maintenance Contracts - AMC for IT equipment, computers, laboratory apparatus, air conditioning, RO water plants, or fire extinguishers), advance payment may be made up to the amount payable for six months under the contract.
3. Security and Guarantees: While sanctioning an advance payment up to six months, the competent authority / DDO must ensure that adequate financial security—such as a Performance Bank Guarantee (PBG) or security deposit—is obtained from the service provider to safeguard public exchequer against contractual default.

questions.question_english: What is the fundamental principle of 'pay fixation' under Fundamental Rule 22(I)(a)(1) [FR 22(I)(a)(1)] upon promotion to a post carrying higher responsibilities?
options_english: Pay is fixed directly at minimum cell of promoted level without added increment.
One increment is added to pay, then fixed at next higher cell in new level.
Existing basic pay remains unchanged while granting temporary personal allowance.
Pay is fixed equal to maximum permissible cell of lower pre-promoted level.
questions.explanation_english:
Under **Fundamental Rule 22(I)(a)(1)** and 7th Central Pay Commission (CPC) Pay Matrix guidelines:

1. **Core Principle of Pay Fixation on Promotion**:
   - When a government employee (such as a Vice Principal promoted to Principal or a PGT promoted to Vice Principal) is appointed to a post involving higher responsibilities, pay fixation is done as follows:
     - **Step 1**: One notional increment is granted in the lower Level from which the employee is promoted (by moving vertically down to the next cell in the existing lower level).
     - **Step 2**: The figure arrived at is then located in the higher Level (promoted post). If a cell equal to that figure exists in the promoted Level, pay is fixed at that cell. If no such cell exists, pay is fixed at the **next immediately higher cell** in that promoted Level.
2. **Option for Date of Fixation**: The employee also holds the option under FR 22(I)(a)(1) to get pay fixed either from the date of promotion or from the date of their next annual increment in the lower feeder grade.
questions.explanation_hindi:
**मूलभूत नियम 22(I)(a)(1) [FR 22(I)(a)(1)]** तथा 7वें केंद्रीय वेतन आयोग (CPC) के पे मैट्रिक्स नियमों के अनुसार:

1. **पदोन्नति पर वेतन निर्धारण का मूल सिद्धांत**:
   - जब किसी सरकारी कर्मचारी (जैसे वाइस प्रिंसिपल से प्रिंसिपल या पीजीटी से वाइस प्रिंसिपल) को उच्चतर जिम्मेदारियों वाले पद पर पदोन्नत किया जाता है, तो वेतन निर्धारण की प्रक्रिया निम्नानुसार होती है:
     - **चरण 1**: निचले स्तर (फीडर ग्रेड) में एक काल्पनिक वेतन वृद्धि (Notional Increment) दी जाती है (अर्थात वर्तमान लेवल में ऊर्ध्वाधर नीचे के अगले सेल पर जाया जाता है)।
     - **चरण 2**: प्राप्त वेतन आंकड़े को पदोन्नत उच्च स्तर (पे लेवल) में खोजा जाता है। यदि उच्च लेवल में उस आंकड़े के बराबर कोई सेल उपलब्ध है, तो वेतन वहां निर्धारित होता है; यदि बराबर सेल नहीं है, तो उच्च लेवल के **ठीक अगले उच्चतर सेल (Next higher cell)** पर वेतन निर्धारित किया जाता है।
2. **विकल्प की सुविधा**: कर्मचारी को यह अधिकार भी होता है कि वह पदोन्नति की तिथि से अथवा अपने निचले पद की आगामी वार्षिक वेतन वृद्धि की तिथि से वेतन निर्धारण का विकल्प (Option) चुन सके।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (B) One increment is added to pay, then fixed at next higher cell in new level.

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: next higher cell in new level. Under Fundamental Rule 22(I)(a)(1), pay fixation upon promotion involving higher responsibilities requires adding one notional increment in the lower pay scale first. The pay is then fixed at the cell equal to or immediately higher than that figure in the level of the higher promoted post in the pay matrix.

questions.explanation_english: In educational institutions administered under the Directorate of Education (DoE) and General Financial Rules (GFR), the Head of School (Principal/Vice-Principal) functions as the Drawing and Disbursing Officer (DDO) and administrative head responsible for maintaining accurate muster rolls and certifying attendance for salary bills. questions.explanation_hindi: शिक्षा निदेशालय (DoE) और सामान्य वित्तीय नियम (GFR) के तहत, स्कूल प्रमुख (प्रधानाचार्य) आहरण एवं संवितरण अधिकारी (DDO) के रूप में कार्य करते हैं और कर्मचारियों के मासिक उपस्थिति रिकॉर्ड और वेतन बिलों के प्रमाणीकरण के लिए जिम्मेदार होते हैं। यदि आधार सक्षम बायोमेट्रिक उपस्थिति प्रणाली (AEBAS) में तकनीकी खराबी आती है, तो मानक प्रशासनिक प्रक्रिया के अनुसार समानांतर रूप से एक भौतिक (मैनुअल) उपस्थिति रजिस्टर तुरंत चालू किया जाना चाहिए जिस पर स्कूल प्रमुख के दैनिक हस्ताक्षर हों। इसके साथ ही समस्या के त्वरित समाधान हेतु संबंधित IT शाखा या वेंडर के पास आधिकारिक सपोर्ट टिकट/शिकायत दर्ज की जानी चाहिए। बिना सत्यापन कर्मचारियों का वेतन काटना या छात्रों से शिक्षकों की उपस्थिति दर्ज करवाना नियम विरुद्ध और अनुचित है।

questions.question_english: Under the General Provident Fund (Central Services) Rules, 1960, for which of the following purposes can an advance NOT be legally sanctioned or drawn from the GPF account?
options_english: Meeting prolonged or emergent medical treatment expenses for the subscriber or their family dependents.
Financing higher professional, technical, or specialized education of the subscriber's children.
Purchasing a luxury motor car for personal touring and holiday travel.
Meeting obligatory expenses in connection with marriages, funerals, or ceremonies of family members.
questions.explanation_english:
The General Provident Fund (Central Services) Rules, 1960 regulate both refundable advances (Rule 12) and non-refundable withdrawals (Rule 15).

Statutory Provisions for GPF Advances (Rule 12):
1. Permissible Purposes for GPF Advances under Rule 12(1):
   - Illness of the subscriber or any person actually dependent on him/her.
   - Education (overseas education or higher technical/specialized education within India lasting over 3 years).
   - Obligatory expenses connected with betrothals, marriages, funerals, or other ceremonies.
   - Legal proceedings instituted by or against the subscriber.
   - Defense of a subscriber prosecuted for alleged official acts.
2. Non-Permissible Purposes: An advance under Rule 12 cannot be drawn for commercial speculation, recreation, luxury purchases, or personal leisure touring. (Note: Under Rule 15-B/15-C, a non-refundable withdrawal may be permitted for purchase of a motor vehicle under strictly defined length-of-service conditions, but drawing a refundable *advance* for purchasing a luxury car for touring is strictly barred).

Thus, Option (C) represents a non-permissible purpose.
questions.explanation_hindi:
सामान्य भविष्य निधि (केंद्रीय सेवाएं) नियम, 1960 के नियम 12 के अंतर्गत जीपीएफ खाते से प्रतिदेय अग्रिम (Refundable Advance) स्वीकृत करने के विशिष्ट वैधानिक उद्देश्य निर्धारित हैं।

नियम 12 के अंतर्गत अनुज्ञेय उद्देश्य:
1. बीमारी: स्वयं कर्मचारी अथवा उस पर आश्रित परिवार के सदस्यों के गंभीर व आकस्मिक चिकित्सा उपचार हेतु।
2. उच्च शिक्षा: आश्रित बच्चों की उच्च तकनीकी, व्यावसायिक या विशेष शिक्षा (भारत या विदेश में)।
3. अनिवार्य पारिवारिक संस्कार: विवाह, सगाई, अंतिम संस्कार अथवा अन्य अनिवार्य सामाजिक-धार्मिक रीति-रिवाजों के खर्च।

questions.question_english: Consider the following scenario: A Drawing and Disbursing Officer (DDO) / Head of School discovers that a sum of ₹10,000 has been fraudulently withdrawn from the school's non-plan government account. What is the mandatory immediate requirement under Rule 33 of the General Financial Rules (GFR), 2017?
options_english: The DDO should personally make good the deficit immediately from personal funds to avoid audit objections.
Maintain strict institutional confidentiality until internal departmental fact-finding is fully concluded.
Defer taking action until the close of the financial year and formally apply for a write-off sanction.
Immediately report the loss to the next higher administrative authority as well as to the Statutory Audit Officer.
questions.explanation_english:
Rule 33 of the General Financial Rules (GFR), 2017 explicitly governs the statutory procedure for reporting losses of public money, stores, or property.

Statutory Mandate of GFR Rule 33 (Report of Losses):
1. Mandatory Immediate Reporting: 'Any loss or shortage of public moneys, revenue or receipts, stamps, opium, stores or other property held by, or on behalf of Government, caused by defalcation or otherwise, which is discovered in a treasury or other office or department, shall be immediately reported by the officer concerned to the next higher authority as well as to the Statutory Audit Officer and to the concerned Principal Accounts Officer.'
2. Recovery Does Not Waive Reporting: Even if the person responsible has made good the loss or promises to refund it, the mandatory report cannot be withheld.
3. Detailed Inquiry Report: An initial prompt report must be submitted immediately, followed by a detailed inquiry report indicating the nature and extent of the loss, the systemic or supervisory lapse that enabled the fraud, and the remedial disciplinary/legal steps initiated.
4. Flaws in Other Options: Suppressing the matter (Option B), personal reimbursement without reporting (Option A), or waiting for year-end write-off (Option C) constitute serious procedural violations under financial canons of propriety.

Hence, Option (D) is the strictly correct statutory response.
questions.explanation_hindi:
सामान्य वित्तीय नियम (GFR), 2017 का नियम 33 सरकारी धन, राजस्व अथवा संपत्ति के नुकसान और गबन की रिपोर्टिंग के संबंध में स्पष्ट और अनिवार्य कानूनी प्रक्रिया निर्धारित करता है।

GFR नियम 33 (Report of Losses) के प्रमुख प्रावधान:
1. अविलंब रिपोर्टिंग की अनिवार्यता: किसी भी कार्यालय, विद्यालय अथवा विभाग में जब भी गबन, धोखाधड़ी, जालसाजी या लापरवाही के कारण सरकारी धन का नुकसान पाया जाए, तो संबंधित अधिकारी (DDO/HOS) का यह प्राथमिक कानूनी कर्तव्य है कि वह इसकी सूचना तुरंत अपने अगले उच्च प्रशासनिक प्राधिकारी (जैसे उप-शिक्षा निदेशक/DDE) तथा वैधानिक लेखापरीक्षा अधिकारी (Statutory Audit Officer / PAG Delhi) और संबंधित वेतन एवं लेखा कार्यालय (PAO) को प्रेषित करे।
2. क्षतिपूर्ति से छूट नहीं: भले ही दोषी व्यक्ति ने राशि जमा कर दी हो या नुकसान की भरपाई हो गई हो, तब भी इस अनिवार्य रिपोर्ट को रोका नहीं जा सकता।
3. विस्तृत जांच: प्रारंभिक रिपोर्ट के बाद एक विस्तृत जांच रिपोर्ट भेजी जाती है जिसमें गबन की कार्यप्रणाली, प्रणालीगत खामियों तथा जिम्मेदार व्यक्तियों के विरुद्ध शुरू की गई अनुशासनात्मक/आपराधिक कार्रवाई का विवरण होता है।
4. अन्य विकल्पों की त्रुटि: मामले को छिपाना (विकल्प B), बिना सूचना के अपनी जेब से भरपाई करना (विकल्प A), अथवा वित्तीय वर्ष के अंत तक प्रतीक्षा करना (विकल्प C) वित्तीय औचित्य के नियमों का घोर उल्लंघन है।

अतः सही उत्तर विकल्प (D) है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (D) Immediately report loss to next higher authority and Statutory Audit Officer

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Under Rule 33 of General Financial Rules 2017, whenever a Drawing and Disbursing Officer detects fraud, embezzlement, or loss of public money, the loss must be reported immediately to the next higher administrative authority and the Statutory Audit Officer. Prompt reporting ensures immediate investigation and safeguards departmental financial accountability.

questions.explanation_english:
Rule 145 of the Delhi School Education Rules (DSER), 1973, situated within Chapter XII ('Admission to Recognised Schools'), establishes the statutory framework and regulatory procedure governing student admissions in all recognized schools across the National Capital Territory of Delhi.

Key statutory aspects governed by Rule 145 and Chapter XII include:
1. Admission Mandates: It sets out the formal requirements for student entry, including age verification, submission of transfer certificates, and non-discrimination mandates.
2. Admission Registers: Every recognized school is required under DSER provisions to maintain standardized admission registers, record student credentials, and maintain records of applications and withdrawals.
3. Comparison with other Rules: The Scheme of Management is governed under Rule 59 (Chapter V); Code of Conduct for Teachers is codified under Rule 123 (Chapter VIII); and the Duties and Responsibilities of the Head of School are elaborated under Rule 59 read with Rule 105 and respective executive circulars issued by the Directorate of Education (DoE). questions.explanation_english: Fundamental Rule 56 (FR 56) is the cornerstone provision governing the age of compulsory retirement (superannuation) of civil servants under the Government of India. FR 56(a) prescribes that every government servant shall retire from service on the afternoon of the last day of the month in which they attain the age of sixty years (with special provisions for those born on the first day of a month). Furthermore, FR 56(j) and 56(l) provide statutory powers to the Appropriate Authority to prematurely retire government servants in public interest upon attaining a specified age (50/55 years) or completing 30 years of qualifying service, while FR 56(k) and 56(m) govern voluntary retirement.
questions.explanation_hindi: मूल नियम 56 (FR 56) भारत सरकार के अधीन सिविल सेवकों की सेवानिवृत्ति की आयु और अधिवर्षिता (Superannuation) को नियंत्रित करने वाला मुख्य वैधानिक नियम है। FR 56(a) के अनुसार प्रत्येक सरकारी कर्मचारी उस महीने के अंतिम दिन दोपहर बाद सेवानिवृत्त होगा जिसमें वह 60 वर्ष की आयु प्राप्त करता है। इसके अतिरिक्त, FR 56(j) और (l) सक्षम प्राधिकारी को जनहित में 50/55 वर्ष की आयु या 30 वर्ष की अर्हक सेवा पूरी होने पर किसी अक्षम या संदिग्ध सत्यनिष्ठा वाले कर्मचारी को समय-पूर्व अनिवार्य सेवानिवृत्ति देने का अधिकार देते हैं, तथा FR 56(k) स्वैच्छिक सेवानिवृत्ति से संबंधित है।

questions.question_english: Rule 50 of the Delhi School Education Rules (DSER), 1973 specifies conditions for the recognition of schools. Which of the following is an essential statutory condition prescribed under this rule?

questions.explanation_english: Rule 50 of the Delhi School Education Rules, 1973 (DSER 1973) outlines the mandatory conditions that a society or trust must satisfy to obtain and retain recognition for a school. Sub-rule (1)(i) explicitly mandates that the managing committee or sponsoring society must create and maintain an adequate reserve fund in a joint account in the name of the Director of Education (or designated education officer) and the manager of the school. This statutory reserve fund acts as a financial guarantee to safeguard the payment of teachers' and employees' salaries and discharge institutional liabilities in case the school management defaults. Air-conditioning, high tuition fees, or arbitrary massive enrollment thresholds are not statutory requirements under Rule 50.
questions.explanation_hindi: दिल्ली स्कूल शिक्षा नियम, 1973 के नियम 50 के तहत किसी भी स्कूल को मान्यता प्राप्त करने और बनाए रखने के लिए अनिवार्य शर्तों का उल्लेख किया गया है। इसके उप-नियम (1)(i) में स्पष्ट रूप से प्रावधान है कि स्कूल की प्रबंध समिति या प्रायोजक संस्था को शिक्षा निदेशक (या संबंधित शिक्षा अधिकारी) तथा स्कूल प्रबंधक के संयुक्त नाम से एक बैंक खाते में पर्याप्त 'आरक्षित निधि' (Reserve Fund) स्थापित करनी और बनाए रखनी होगी। इस आरक्षित निधि का मुख्य उद्देश्य विद्यालय की वित्तीय स्थिरता सुनिश्चित करना तथा प्रबंध तंत्र द्वारा किसी चूक की स्थिति में शिक्षकों और कर्मचारियों के वेतन व अन्य देयताओं की सुरक्षा करना है। वातानुकूलित कमरे या अत्यधिक फीस जैसी शर्तें इसमें शामिल नहीं हैं।

Consider the following statements regarding the Central Civil Services (Conduct) Rules, 1964:
I. A government servant is legally entitled to participate in a strike if formally sponsored by a recognized service union.
II. A government servant must maintain strict political neutrality and refrain from political affiliations.
III. Prior sanction of the prescribed authority is required before acquiring or disposing of immovable property.
IV. Adverse criticism of government policy in public speeches is permissible provided the employee acts anonymously.
Which of the statement(s) given above is/are correct?
options_english: I and II only
II and III only
III and IV only
I, II and IV
questions.explanation_english:
An analysis of the provisions of the CCS (Conduct) Rules, 1964 reveals:

1. Statement I is incorrect: Rule 7 explicitly prohibits government servants from engaging in or participating in any demonstration or strike in connection with any matter pertaining to service conditions. No recognized union has the legal power to exempt employees from this statutory bar.
2. Statement II is correct: Rule 5 mandates absolute political neutrality. A government servant cannot be a member of, or be associated with, any political party, nor participate in political canvassing or elections.
3. Statement III is correct: Under Rule 18(2), prior knowledge/prior sanction of the prescribed authority is mandatory for acquiring or disposing of any immovable property (land, building, flat), whether through lease, mortgage, purchase, or gift, either in the employee's own name or through a family member.
4. Statement IV is incorrect: Rule 9 strictly bans any criticism of Government in radio broadcasts, television, print/digital media, or public speeches, regardless of whether it is done in one's own name, anonymously, or pseudonymously.

Consequently, only Statements II and III are correct (Option B).

Consider the following statements regarding the Contingent Register maintained in government offices and schools:
I. It is maintained to record recurring and non-recurring operational expenditures incurred on contingencies such as stationery, postage, utilities, and minor repairs.
II. It is prescribed to be maintained in Form GAR-27.

questions.explanation_english:
Statements I and II are correct, while Statement III is incorrect:
- Statement I is correct: Under Rule 96 and Rule 110 of the Central Government Account (Receipts and Payments) Rules, 1983, a Contingent Register is maintained by DDOs to record all incidental and operational expenditures incurred on day-to-day office contingencies such as stationery, postage, telephone, minor repairs, and sanitation.

- Statement III is incorrect: The Contingent Register is an internal subsidiary control ledger; it cannot replace or substitute the primary Cash Book (maintained in Form GAR-3), which is legally mandated to record every receipt and cash/bank disbursement.
questions.explanation_hindi:
कथन I और II सही हैं, जबकि कथन III गलत है:
- कथन I सही है: केंद्रीय सरकार लेखा (प्राप्ति एवं भुगतान) नियमावली के तहत आकस्मिक व्यय रजिस्टर का संधारण कार्यालय संचालन हेतु आवश्यक दैनिक आकस्मिक खर्चों जैसे लेखन सामग्री (स्टेशनरी), डाक, दूरभाष, लघु मरम्मत एवं अन्य कार्यालयीन व्ययों का हिसाब रखने के लिए किया जाता है।

- कथन III गलत है: आकस्मिक व्यय रजिस्टर एक सहायक नियंत्रण पंजिका (subsidiary ledger) है। यह किसी भी स्थिति में मुख्य रोकड़ बही (GAR-3) का स्थान या विकल्प नहीं ले सकता, जिसमें सभी वित्तीय प्राप्तियों और संवितरणों का आधिकारिक रिकॉर्ड रखा जाता है।

questions.question_english: The RTI Act 2005 mandates proactive disclosure of information by public authorities. Which section of the Act contains this provision?
options_english: Section 4(1)(b)
Section 6(1)
Section 8(1)
Section 19
questions.explanation_english:
Section 4(1)(b) of the Right to Information (RTI) Act, 2005 is the central provision governing proactive, voluntary, or suo motu disclosure by all public authorities, including the Directorate of Education (DoE) and government schools.

Key aspects of Section 4(1)(b):
1. Seventeen Manuals: It mandates that every public authority must publish within 120 days of the enactment of the Act, and update annually, seventeen specific categories of information.
2. Scope of Disclosures: These proactive disclosures include:
   - Organizational structure, functions, and duties.
   - Powers and duties of officers and employees.
   - Decision-making process, supervisory channels, and norms for discharge of functions.
   - Rules, regulations, instructions, manuals, and records used by employees.
   - Directory of officers, monthly remuneration received, and budget allocations.
   - Particulars of concessions, permits, or authorizations granted, and facilities available to citizens.
3. Reduction of Formal Requests: The explicit objective of Section 4(1)(b) is to provide as much information suo motu to the public at regular intervals through various means of communications (including websites) so that citizens have minimal resort to filing formal RTI applications under Section 6.

Other sections referenced:
- Section 6(1): Filing a formal application for obtaining information.
- Section 8(1): Specific exemptions from disclosure (national security, fiduciary relations, personal privacy, etc.).
- Section 19: Appeals mechanism (First Appeal to FAA and Second Appeal to Information Commission).

Therefore, Section 4(1)(b) contains the mandate for proactive disclosure, making Option (A) the correct answer.
questions.explanation_hindi:
सूचना का अधिकार (RTI) अधिनियम, 2005 की धारा 4(1)(b) प्रत्येक लोक प्राधिकारी (Public Authority)—जिसमें शिक्षा निदेशालय और सभी सरकारी विद्यालय शामिल हैं—द्वारा सूचनाओं के स्वतः संज्ञान प्रकटीकरण (Proactive/Suo Motu Disclosure) का केंद्रीय विधिक प्रावधान है।

धारा 4(1)(b) के प्रमुख घटक:
1. सत्रह (17) नियमावलियों का प्रकाशन: इसके तहत अधिनियम के लागू होने के 120 दिनों के भीतर तथा उसके बाद प्रतिवर्ष 17 विशिष्ट श्रेणियों में सूचनाओं का प्रकाशन और निरंतर अद्यतन करना अनिवार्य है।
2. प्रकटीकरण का दायरा:
   - संगठन की संरचना, कार्य और कर्तव्य।
   - अधिकारियों और कर्मचारियों की शक्तियां व दायित्व।
   - निर्णय लेने की प्रक्रिया, पर्यवेक्षण के चैनल और कार्य संपादन के मानदंड।
   - कर्मचारियों द्वारा उपयोग किए जाने वाले नियम, विनियम, निर्देश और अभिलेख।
   - अधिकारियों की निर्देशिका, मासिक पारिश्रमिक तथा बजटीय आवंटन।
   - प्रदत्त रियायतों, परमिटों का विवरण तथा नागरिकों के लिए उपलब्ध सुविधाएं।
3. औपचारिक आवेदनों में कमी: इस धारा का मुख्य उद्देश्य यह है कि नागरिकों को सूचना पाने के लिए धारा 6(1) के तहत औपचारिक आवेदन करने की आवश्यकता ही न पड़े और सार्वजनिक पोर्टल पर अधिकांश जानकारी पहले से उपलब्ध रहे।

अन्य विकल्पों का विश्लेषण:
- धारा 6(1): सूचना प्राप्त करने हेतु औपचारिक आवेदन करने की प्रक्रिया।
- धारा 8(1): सूचना प्रकटीकरण से छूट प्राप्त विषय (Exemptions)।
- धारा 19: अपीलीय तंत्र (प्रथम अपील और केंद्रीय/राज्य सूचना आयोग में द्वितीय अपील)।

अतः स्वतः प्रकटीकरण का प्रावधान धारा 4(1)(b) में निहित है, जिससे विकल्प (A) सही उत्तर है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (A) Section 4(1)(b)

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Section 4(1)(b) of the Right to Information Act 2005 obligates every public authority to proactively publish details regarding its organization, functions, duties, financial allocations, and decision-making processes. This voluntary disclosure aims to foster operational transparency, reduce individual information requests, and promote public accountability across all administrative bodies.

questions.question_english: Under the provisions of Section 16 of the Delhi School Education Act (DSEA), 1973, what is the mandatory legal procedure if a recognized school proposes to close down the school or any class in the school?
options_english: The school can close operations immediately upon issuing a one-month formal notice to the parents
The school must obtain the prior written approval of the Director of Education
The school must mandatorily surrender and transfer all physical assets to the local municipal body
The school only needs to send an official informational letter to the CBSE and the affiliating board
questions.explanation_english:
Section 16 of the Delhi School Education Act, 1973 (DSEA 1973) specifically mandates the procedure for the closure of recognized schools and classes:
1. Statutory Prohibition: Section 16 stipulates that no recognized school shall close down any school or any class in a recognized school without the prior approval of the Director of Education.
2. Protection of Academic Continuity: The statutory objective of Section 16 is to prevent arbitrary, commercial, or sudden closures by private school managements that leave admitted students stranded midway through their academic session without alternate schooling.
3. Student Re-allocation Mandate: Before any closure is sanctioned, the Directorate of Education (DoE) requires the management to submit a comprehensive plan for accommodating and smoothly re-allocating enrolled students to nearby recognized government or private schools in the neighborhood, ensuring no child is denied their fundamental right to education.
4. Employee Protection: Under Sections 8 and 10 of DSEAR 1973, the service conditions, terminal benefits, and tenure of teaching and non-teaching employees must also be legally resolved and safeguarded prior to approval.

Therefore, the prior written approval of the Director of Education is an indispensable statutory requirement.
questions.explanation_hindi:
दिल्ली स्कूल शिक्षा अधिनियम (DSEA), 1973 की धारा 16 में मान्यता प्राप्त विद्यालयों अथवा कक्षाओं को बंद करने के संबंध में कड़े वैधानिक प्रावधान किए गए हैं:
1. पूर्व अनुमोदन की सांविधिक अनिवार्यता: धारा 16 के अनुसार, कोई भी मान्यता प्राप्त विद्यालय अथवा उसकी प्रबंध समिति (Managing Committee), शिक्षा निदेशक (Director of Education) की पूर्व लिखित स्वीकृति के बिना विद्यालय अथवा उसकी किसी भी कक्षा को बंद नहीं कर सकती।
2. छात्रों की शिक्षा में निरंतरता की सुरक्षा: इस प्रावधान का मूल उद्देश्य यह है कि निजी स्कूल प्रबंधन मनमाने ढंग से अथवा व्यावसायिक लाभ-हानि के आधार पर सत्र के मध्य में अचानक स्कूल बंद न करें, जिससे छात्रों की पढ़ाई और भविष्य अधर में लटक जाए।
3. छात्रों का पुनर्आवंटन (Re-allocation): किसी भी विद्यालय को बंद करने की स्वीकृति देने से पूर्व शिक्षा निदेशालय यह सुनिश्चित करता है कि नामांकित सभी छात्रों को निकटवर्ती सरकारी अथवा अन्य मान्यता प्राप्त विद्यालयों में बिना किसी शैक्षणिक नुकसान के प्रवेश दिलाया जाए।
4. शिक्षकों व कर्मचारियों की सुरक्षा: अधिनियम की धारा 8 और 10 के तहत कर्मचारियों के वेतन, ग्रेच्युटी तथा सेवा शर्तों की विधिक सुरक्षा सुनिश्चित करना भी अनिवार्य होता है।

अतः शिक्षा निदेशक (Director of Education) की पूर्व लिखित स्वीकृति अनिवार्य है।

questions.question_english:
Given below are two statements: one is labelled as Assertion (A) and the other is labelled as Reason (R).
Assertion (A): Suspension of a government servant is not classified as a penalty under the CCS (CCA) Rules, 1965.
Reason (R): Suspension is an executive administrative measure taken to keep a government servant away from duty pending inquiry or investigation into alleged misconduct.
In the context of the statements above, which of the following is correct?
options_english: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true, but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true, but R is false
A is false, but R is true
questions.explanation_english: Under Rule 11 of the Central Civil Services (Classification, Control and Appeal) Rules, 1965, the statutory penalties that can be imposed on a government servant are classified into Minor Penalties (such as censure, withholding of promotion, recovery from pay, withholding of increments) and Major Penalties (such as reduction to a lower stage/grade, compulsory retirement, removal from service, dismissal). Suspension is governed separately under Rule 10 of the CCS (CCA) Rules, 1965. Suspension is an administrative step taken where disciplinary proceedings are contemplated or pending, or where a criminal case is under investigation, in order to prevent tampering with witnesses/records or prejudice to public interest. Because it is an interim administrative measure rather than a punitive adjudication of guilt, it is not a penalty. Thus, both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true, and Reason (R) directly explains Assertion (A).
questions.explanation_hindi: CCS (वर्गीकरण, नियंत्रण और अपील) नियम, 1965 के नियम 11 के तहत केवल लघु शास्तियों (जैसे परिनिंदा, पदोन्नति रोकना, वेतन वृद्धि रोकना) और दीर्घ शास्तियों (जैसे पदावनति, अनिवार्य सेवानिवृत्ति, सेवा से हटाया जाना या बर्खास्तगी) को ही दंड (Penalty) माना गया है। निलंबन (Suspension) नियम 10 के तहत एक प्रशासनिक आदेश है, जिसे किसी गंभीर कदाचार या आपराधिक मामले की जांच लंबित रहने के दौरान कर्मचारी को पद के दुरुपयोग या साक्ष्यों को प्रभावित करने से रोकने के लिए किया जाता है। चूंकि यह कोई न्यायिक या अनुशासनात्मक अंतिम दंड नहीं है, इसलिए निलंबन को दंड नहीं माना जाता। अतः अभिकथन (A) और कारण (R) दोनों सही हैं, और R, A का सही स्पष्टीकरण है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (A) Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Suspension is an executive action taken to keep an employee away from official duties pending an inquiry, safeguarding evidence and administrative proceedings. Because it does not constitute a disciplinary punishment, suspension is not classified as a penalty under Rule 11 of the CCS Classification, Control and Appeal Rules 1965.

questions.question_english: Which statutory legislation imposes an affirmative mandatory legal duty upon school heads, teachers, and staff to immediately report any knowledge or reasonable apprehension of sexual abuse of a minor student to the Special Juvenile Police Unit (SJPU) or the local police station?
options_english: Right of Children to Free and Compulsory Education (RTE) Act, 2009
Delhi School Education Act and Rules (DSEAR), 1973
Protection of Children from Sexual Offences (POCSO) Act, 2012
Juvenile Justice (Care and Protection of Children) Act, 2015
questions.explanation_english: Under Section 19(1) of the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences (POCSO) Act, 2012, any person (including the Head of School, teacher, counselor, or school staff) who has knowledge or apprehension that an offence under this Act has been committed or is likely to be committed shall provide such information to the Special Juvenile Police Unit (SJPU) or the local police. Furthermore, under Section 21 of the POCSO Act, any person in charge of an institution who intentionally fails to report such an offence or fails to supply required information is liable to punishment with imprisonment up to one year, or fine, or both. The Directorate of Education (DoE) Delhi has issued strict circulars mandating zero tolerance and zero delay in reporting child abuse incidents under the POCSO Act.
questions.explanation_hindi: लैंगिक अपराधों से बालकों का संरक्षण (POCSO) अधिनियम, 2012 की धारा 19(1) के अंतर्गत यह अनिवार्य कानूनी दायित्व निर्धारित किया गया है कि यदि किसी भी व्यक्ति (जिसमें विद्यालय प्रमुख, शिक्षक, परामर्शदाता या विद्यालय कर्मचारी शामिल हैं) को यह आशंका या जानकारी होती है कि किसी बच्चे के विरुद्ध यौन अपराध घटित हुआ है या होने की संभावना है, तो वह इसकी सूचना तुरंत विशेष किशोर पुलिस इकाई (SJPU) या स्थानीय पुलिस को देगा। इसके अतिरिक्त, धारा 21 के तहत ऐसे अपराध की सूचना न देने या छिपाने वाले संस्थागत प्रमुख को एक वर्ष तक के कारावास अथवा जुर्माने या दोनों से दंडित करने का कड़ा दंडात्मक प्रावधान है। दिल्ली शिक्षा निदेशालय ने सभी सरकारी और निजी विद्यालयों के लिए इस संबंध में 'जीरो टॉलरेंस' नीति अनिवार्य की है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (C) POCSO Act 2012

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: The Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act 2012 places a mandatory legal duty on school personnel to immediately report any apprehension or knowledge of sexual abuse involving a minor. Failure to report such incidents to the local police or Special Juvenile Police Unit constitutes a punishable offense under statutory provisions.
